docs: `openfiat-presale` — the OPEN token presale program (OFS-4200 §3,
OFS-4100 §3). Phase 3: full sale lifecycle — initialize, contribute
(direct USDC or SOL/stablecoin via atomic Jupiter CPI swap), finalize,
claim, refund.

accounts.name: source_mint
docs: The asset being contributed — must be wSOL or on the stablecoin
whitelist, and must not be USDC (use `contribute_usdc` for that).

accounts.name: swap_program
docs: below. The actual swap accounts are `remaining_accounts`.

accounts.name: sale_config
docs: `sale_nonce` namespaces this sale's PDAs so a new round can be
initialized without redeploying (v1 production usage is a single
sale at nonce 0; the nonce exists so this doesn't have to be a hard
global singleton).

accounts.name: presale_vault_authority
docs: used only as the expected owner of `presale_vault`. It signs
`claim`'s OPEN transfer later; never read/written here.

accounts.name: presale_vault
docs: The Community Presale allocation bucket, already funded at genesis
(Phase 2) — verified here, not created here.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Destination for collected USDC once finalized (e.g. a treasury
multisig's ATA). Not created or owned by this program.

accounts.name: swap_program
docs: `sale_config.swap_program` — see `contribute_with_swap` for why this
program isn't invoked or validated further here. Production
devnet/mainnet deployments must pass Jupiter's real, independently
verified aggregator program id; test/CI deployments may pass a
deterministic mock instead.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the sale admin may perform this action

errors.name: WhitelistTooLong
errors.msg: Stablecoin whitelist may not exceed MAX_STABLECOINS entries

errors.name: HardCapNotGreaterThanSoftCap
errors.msg: hard_cap must be greater than soft_cap

errors.name: InvalidContributionBounds
errors.msg: min_contribution must be greater than zero and at most max_contribution

errors.name: InvalidSaleWindow
errors.msg: end_time must be after start_time

errors.name: InvalidSlippageBps
errors.msg: max_slippage_bps must be between 1 and 10_000

errors.name: SaleNotStarted
errors.msg: The sale has not started yet

errors.name: SaleEnded
errors.msg: The sale has already ended

errors.name: SaleNotActive
errors.msg: The sale is not in the Active state

errors.name: AssetNotWhitelisted
errors.msg: This asset is not on the presale's accepted-stablecoin whitelist

errors.name: UseDirectUsdcPath
errors.msg: Use contribute_usdc for direct USDC contributions instead

errors.name: BelowMinimumContribution
errors.msg: This contribution would be below the minimum required for a wallet's first contribution

errors.name: AboveMaximumContribution
errors.msg: This contribution would exceed the maximum allowed per wallet

errors.name: HardCapExceeded
errors.msg: This contribution would exceed the sale's hard cap

errors.name: SwapProgramMismatch
errors.msg: The swap program account does not match sale_config.swap_program

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: The swap's actual USDC output was below the required minimum (slippage exceeded)

errors.name: SaleNotEnded
errors.msg: The sale has not ended yet

errors.name: SaleAlreadyResolved
errors.msg: The sale has already been finalized or resolved

errors.name: SaleNotFinalized
errors.msg: Claims are only allowed after the sale has been finalized

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This contribution has already been claimed

errors.name: SaleNotRefundable
errors.msg: Refunds are only allowed when the sale's soft cap was missed

errors.name: AlreadyRefunded
errors.msg: This contribution has already been refunded

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

types.name: Contribution
docs: Per-buyer contribution record: PDA seeds `[CONTRIBUTION_SEED, sale_config, buyer]`.

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: Cumulative USDC-equivalent contributed by this wallet, base units.

fields.name: open_entitlement
docs: OPEN base units this wallet is entitled to claim (1:1 with amount_usdc
at the mint's decimals — OFS-4100 §3 confirms no presale vesting).

types.name: InitializeSaleParams
docs: Bundled instead of flattened so the generated `#[program]` dispatch entry
point stays under clippy's too-many-arguments threshold, and so a future
added field doesn't ripple through every caller's positional arg list.

types.name: SaleConfig
docs: Singleton sale configuration + running state (OFS-4200 §3, OFS-4100 §3).
All economic parameters below are set once at `initialize_sale` from
OFS-4100 §3's PROPOSED figures — they are instruction arguments, not
compile-time constants, specifically so a later tokenomics sign-off
(or a devnet-vs-mainnet difference) never requires a code change, only a
different `initialize_sale` call.

fields.name: open_mint
docs: The OPEN token mint (fixed supply, genesis-minted — see Phase 2).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC mint contributions are ultimately valued/held in.

fields.name: presale_vault
docs: Community Presale allocation bucket (OFS-4100 §2), owned by the
`presale_vault` PDA — `claim` transfers out of this account.

fields.name: usdc_vault
docs: USDC escrow token account (owned by this `SaleConfig` PDA itself)
that holds contributions until `finalize_sale` sweeps them to
`treasury`, or `refund` returns them if the soft cap is missed.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination for collected USDC once the sale finalizes successfully.

fields.name: swap_program
docs: The trusted swap-aggregator program CPI'd into by `contribute_with_swap`.
Production devnet/mainnet deployments must set this to Jupiter's real,
verified aggregator program id; test/CI deployments may point it at a
deterministic mock so the swap-forwarding logic is testable without a
live, flaky mainnet-state clone. See `contribute_with_swap` for why
this is safe regardless of which program is configured here: the
*result* (a verified balance increase in `usdc_vault`) is what's
trusted, not any account layout internal to this program.

fields.name: hard_cap
docs: USDC base units (6 decimals). OFS-4100 §3 proposes 30_000_000_000_000.

fields.name: soft_cap
docs: USDC base units. OFS-4100 §3 proposes 5_000_000_000_000.

fields.name: min_contribution
docs: USDC base units, applies to a wallet's first contribution only.

fields.name: max_contribution
docs: USDC base units, applies to a wallet's cumulative contributions.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
docs: Basis points; a swap whose realized output falls below
`expected_out * (10_000 - max_slippage_bps) / 10_000` is rejected.

fields.name: open_decimals
docs: Cached from `open_mint`/`usdc_mint` at `initialize_sale` so later
instructions don't need to pass the mint accounts just to read
decimals. `initialize_sale` requires open_decimals >= usdc_decimals
so the USDC->OPEN scale-up below never underflows.

fields.name: total_raised
docs: Running total of USDC-equivalent raised, in USDC base units.

types.name: SaleState
docs: Lifecycle state of the presale (OFS-4200 §3).
`Active -> Finalized` (hard cap reached, or end_time passed with soft cap
met) or `Active -> SoftCapMissed` (end_time passed, soft cap unmet) are
the only two transitions out of `Active`; both are terminal.

constants.name: BPS_DENOMINATOR
docs: Basis-points denominator (10_000 = 100%).

constants.name: CONTRIBUTION_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a per-buyer `Contribution` record: [SEED, sale_config, buyer].

constants.name: PRESALE_VAULT_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the OPEN token vault holding the Community Presale
allocation bucket (owner set at genesis — see ../scripts/genesis.ts).

constants.name: SALE_CONFIG_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the singleton `SaleConfig` account (OFS-4200 §3).

constants.name: SALE_USDC_VAULT_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the USDC escrow vault that holds contributions until
`finalize_sale` sweeps them to the treasury (or `refund` returns them).
